description: Validates dependency readiness, governance, runtime status, release-age policy, and graph drift.

capabilities.label: Surface Inventory
capabilities.description: Dependency surface discovery and language/package-root classification.

levels.name: No dependency target
levels.description: SDA cannot resolve a readable target scenario or dependency surface.
levels.capability_summary: No readable dependency target is available.
levels.next_unlock: A readable scenario with discoverable dependency surfaces.

levels.name: Target readable
levels.description: The target scenario is readable enough for SDA to attempt dependency discovery.
levels.capability_summary: The scenario can be inspected for dependency surfaces.
levels.next_unlock: Supported dependency surfaces with language and package-root evidence.

levels.name: Surfaces classified
levels.description: Dependency surfaces are discovered and classified as supported or explicitly unsupported.
levels.capability_summary: Dependency surfaces are known and unsupported cases are explicit.
levels.next_unlock: Maximum surface-inventory maturity.

levels.name: Inventory clean
levels.description: Surface discovery is clean enough for runtime, package, and governance checks.
levels.capability_summary: Dependency surface inventory is clean and ready for downstream checks.

capabilities.label: Runtime Dependencies
capabilities.description: Required resources and required scenario dependencies are declared, running, and healthy.

levels.name: Runtime manifest unavailable
levels.description: SDA cannot read the target runtime dependency manifest.
levels.capability_summary: Runtime dependencies cannot be evaluated.
levels.next_unlock: Readable service dependency manifest.

levels.name: Manifest readable
levels.description: The target service manifest can be read and dependency declarations can be inspected.
levels.capability_summary: Runtime dependency declarations are readable.
levels.next_unlock: Required resources and scenarios are present in the local runtime catalog.

levels.name: Dependencies present
levels.description: Required resources and scenarios are present in local runtime status.
levels.capability_summary: Required runtime dependencies are known locally.
levels.next_unlock: Required resources and scenarios are running.

levels.name: Dependencies running
levels.description: Required resources and scenarios are running.
levels.capability_summary: Required runtime dependencies are running.
levels.next_unlock: Required resources and scenarios are healthy.

levels.name: Dependencies healthy
levels.description: Required runtime resources and scenario dependencies are healthy.
levels.capability_summary: Runtime dependencies are present, running, and healthy.

capabilities.label: Package Readiness
capabilities.description: Package-manager command availability, version checks, Go module readiness, Node lockfile state, and local Go replace reconciliation.

levels.name: Package checks unavailable
levels.description: Required dependency toolchain commands are unavailable.
levels.capability_summary: Package metadata cannot be evaluated.
levels.next_unlock: Required package manager commands are available.

levels.name: Toolchain available
levels.description: Required package manager commands can be resolved and version-checked.
levels.capability_summary: Dependency toolchain commands are available.
levels.next_unlock: Language-specific package metadata is present.

levels.name: Metadata present
levels.description: Go and Node dependency surfaces declare the expected package metadata files.
levels.capability_summary: Package metadata files are present for discovered surfaces.
levels.next_unlock: Lockfiles, Go replaces, and local install state are coherent.

levels.name: Metadata coherent
levels.description: Go module state, local replaces, Node lockfiles, and local install state are coherent.
levels.capability_summary: Package metadata is coherent enough for local validation and restart.
levels.next_unlock: Maximum package-readiness maturity.

levels.name: Package ready
levels.description: Package metadata and local dependency state are clean.
levels.capability_summary: Package readiness is clean across discovered dependency surfaces.

capabilities.label: Release Age Policy
capabilities.description: pnpm minimum-release-age policy and governed exceptions for JavaScript/TypeScript surfaces.

levels.name: Release policy unreadable
levels.description: SDA cannot read a required pnpm release-age policy.
levels.capability_summary: Release-age policy cannot be evaluated.
levels.next_unlock: Readable pnpm workspace release-age policy.

levels.name: Policy readable
levels.description: pnpm release-age policy files are readable.
levels.capability_summary: Release-age policy files can be parsed.
levels.next_unlock: Minimum release-age gate is configured.

levels.name: Minimum configured
levels.description: pnpm release-age policy declares a minimum age gate.
levels.capability_summary: A minimum release-age gate is present.
levels.next_unlock: Minimum age meets Vrooli's default cooldown.

levels.name: Cooldown enforced
levels.description: The configured release-age minimum meets the Vrooli default cooldown.
levels.capability_summary: New package versions are held behind the default cooldown.
levels.next_unlock: Release-age exclusions are governed.

levels.name: Exceptions governed
levels.description: Release-age exclusions have approved governance records with rationale and review metadata.
levels.capability_summary: Release-age policy and exceptions are governed.

capabilities.label: Dependency Governance
capabilities.description: Approved dependency registry readability and observed dependency approval/denial/deprecation posture.

levels.name: Registry unavailable
levels.description: The approved dependency registry cannot be read or parsed.
levels.capability_summary: Dependency governance cannot be evaluated.
levels.next_unlock: Readable approved dependency registry.

levels.name: Registry readable
levels.description: The approved dependency registry is readable and parseable.
levels.capability_summary: Dependency governance records are available.
levels.next_unlock: Observed direct dependencies are covered by governance decisions.

levels.name: Observed dependencies governed
levels.description: Observed direct dependencies have valid governance state: approved, constrained, denied, deprecated, or needs-review.
levels.capability_summary: Observed dependencies are checked against governance decisions.
levels.next_unlock: Maximum dependency-governance maturity.

levels.name: Governance clean
levels.description: Observed dependency governance has no blocking findings.
levels.capability_summary: Dependency governance is clean for the target scenario.

capabilities.label: Graph Accuracy
capabilities.description: Declared scenario dependencies match observed interface/import evidence.

levels.name: Graph evidence unavailable
levels.description: SDA cannot evaluate dependency graph evidence.
levels.capability_summary: Declared dependency graph accuracy cannot be evaluated.
levels.next_unlock: Import/interface evidence can be compared with service declarations.

levels.name: Graph comparable
levels.description: Declared scenario dependencies can be compared with observed evidence.
levels.capability_summary: Declared dependencies can be checked against interface evidence.
levels.next_unlock: No undeclared usage or stale declarations remain.

levels.name: Graph aligned
levels.description: Declared scenario dependencies align with observed interface/import evidence or documented runtime-only rationale.
levels.capability_summary: Declared dependency graph matches observed evidence.

capabilities.label: Integration Conformance
capabilities.description: Declared scenario dependencies have a shared, health-checkable, operator-actionable capability registry entry and degraded behavior.

levels.name: No scenario dependency
levels.description: The target declares no scenario dependency.
levels.capability_summary: Integration conformance is not applicable.
levels.next_unlock: Declare a scenario dependency to evaluate its integration shape.

levels.name: Dependency resolves
levels.description: Every declared scenario dependency resolves to a real local scenario.
levels.capability_summary: Declared scenario dependencies are discoverable.
levels.next_unlock: Add a matching capability-registry definition for every dependency.

levels.name: Registry describes dependencies
levels.description: Every declared scenario dependency has a registry definition with description, kind, and matching slug.
levels.capability_summary: The capability registry describes the declared integration graph.
levels.next_unlock: Add a reachability checker, operator action, and degraded behavior.

levels.name: Operator-actionable integration
levels.description: Every registry definition is health-checkable and operator-actionable, and degraded behavior is declared.
levels.capability_summary: The integration surface is coherent and recoverable.
levels.next_unlock: Maximum integration-conformance maturity.
